subject: Leadership brief: OKR triage, steward assignments, and QBR readout plan
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Leadership Group <leadership@redwood.com>; jonas_weber@redwood.com; marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 9 Aug 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership brief: OKR triage, steward assignments, and QBR readout plan

Team —

I want to get a short alignment thread going for QBR readiness and the immediate OKR triage before the next Exec readout. I pulled together a first-pass steward slate and a prioritized OKR triage list; both are attached. High level asks: please confirm steward ownership (or propose a swap) and comment on any triage items you think should be escalated to Exec.

Key points:
- QBR audience: Exec + Product + Eng leads (August 18 org readout).
- Goal: present 3 top program risks with mitigation actions and 2 wins tied to metrics.
- Steward assignments (first pass): see steward-assignments.csv — these are 1-2 owners per priority area.
- OKR triage: I prioritized items that materially impact latency/cost/unit economics for inference. Please add quick notes in the doc or reply inline.

Attachments: QBR-readout-draft.pptx (slide deck outline), steward-assignments.csv (small table).

Timeline: please reply with confirmations or suggested swaps by end of day tomorrow (Fri 8/10). Final deck due to me by Tue 8/14 COB so I can consolidate for the ops rehearsal on 8/16.

Thanks — let’s keep this light and actionable.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>; Leadership Group <leadership@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 9 Aug 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership brief: OKR triage, steward assignments, and QBR readout plan

Thanks, Soojin — good framing. Two quick items: 

1) Steward swap: I suggest we move Serving Runtime stewardship for the "latency SLO/ops" item from Marissa to Karthik. Karthik has been leading the kernel selection experiments and can own the mitigation runbook.

2) Triage escalation: the cache-invalidations work looks like it will miss the QBR milestone unless we short-circuit scope. I recommend calling this an "Active Risk" in the deck with a 2-week contingency plan.

If others agree, I can update the deck slide for the risk/mitigation and swap the steward in the CSV.

Agree with the risk callout. A few practical notes from platform: 

- Karthik owning Serving Runtime makes sense operationally; I'll keep a single primary for rollout coordination but will stay on the thread for dependencies.
- I added more color in the attached okr-triage-notes.docx — specifically suggested language for the announcement slide (two bullets that frame the transition as a temporary steward swap for the run of the initiative).
- For the org announcement, let's be explicit about who covers on-call changes for the two weeks following the transition. Naomi, can you confirm coverage with EngOps?

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com; naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 11 Aug 2028 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership brief: OKR triage, steward assignments, and QBR readout plan

Thanks for the quick turn — this is helpful. Decisions: 

- Confirmed: Karthik will be primary steward for Serving Runtime (latency SLO item). Marissa remains accountable for rollout coordination and validation. I updated steward-assignments.csv accordingly.
- Risk callout: cache-invalidations will be marked as an "Active Risk" on the QBR slide with the suggested 2-week contingency plan. Jonas, please drop your slide update into the shared deck.
- Naomi: confirm EngOps coverage for on-call handover by Mon 8/13 so we can reflect the rotation in the announcement.

Next steps and timeline:
- Tue 8/14 COB: final decks in my inbox (I will not accept further structural changes after consolidation).
- Thu 8/16 2:00 PM: ops rehearsal (30 min) — please RSVP.
- Fri 8/18: org readout.

I'll send a short leadership comms draft for the org announcement tomorrow morning. If any of the confirmed owners foresee conflicts with the dates, flag ASAP.

Attachments updated in thread: steward-assignments.csv (v2), QBR-readout-draft.pptx (v3).

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
VP, Product Operations
